## Services
- Residential mortgages: purchases, first-time home buyers, renewals, refinancing, investment properties
- Commercial mortgages: commercial property, business real estate, investment portfolios
- Mortgage renewal: shopping the market at maturity instead of signing the lender's renewal offer
- Refinancing: accessing home equity, lowering payments
- Self-employed mortgages: flexible income verification, stated-income programs
- Debt consolidation: rolling high-interest debt into the mortgage
- Low-credit / bruised-credit mortgages, private and alternative (B) lending

## Calculators on this site
https://modernmortgages.ca/#calculators (deep links: #calc-payment, #calc-afford, #calc-refi, #calc-debt, #calc-ltt)
- Payment: home price, down payment, rate, amortization, frequency (monthly, semi-monthly, bi-weekly, accelerated bi-weekly, weekly, accelerated weekly). Uses Canadian semi-annual compounding; adds CMHC premium when down payment is under 20% (2.80% / 3.10% / 4.00% by loan-to-value, +0.20% for amortizations over 25 years); enforces minimum down payment (5% of first $500k, 10% of the portion to $1.5M, 20% at $1.5M+).
- Affordability: 39% GDS / 44% TDS limits, stress-tested at the greater of contract rate + 2% or 5.25%, includes property tax, heating and 50% of condo fees.
- Refinance / renewal: payment savings, net interest savings after penalty and fees, break-even months.
- Debt consolidation: monthly cash-flow relief, honest long-term interest impact, and savings if the old total payment is kept.
- Land transfer tax: Ontario LTT plus City of Toronto MLTT, with first-time buyer rebates (up to $4,000 Ontario, up to $4,475 Toronto).

## FAQ
- Cost: for most residential mortgages with qualified borrowers there is no fee to the client; the lender pays the broker. Private, alternative or commercial files may involve a fee, disclosed in writing upfront.
- Minimum down payment: 5% of the first $500,000, 10% of the portion from $500,000 to $1,499,999; 20% for $1.5M+.
- Stress test: qualify at the greater of contract rate + 2% or 5.25%.
- Renewals: start 120–150 days before maturity; switching lenders at renewal is often penalty-free.
